body: Quick pass: merges cleanly with main; body complete; no snapshot PNG touched; author's gate green on 90c8810a (ui lib 581, clippy clean, quick gate green). Flagged ready for review. Noted for the reviewer: the Turning row reads "Turning - Turning", and `actions.rs` grew from 433 to 458 lines.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 90c8810a9e571bca70b6b2569346fec3f5d412bf -->
**Needs changes before merge** - the new Plasma mode itself is correct and well pinned, but the ribbon's machine door now shows the long menu-row text, and two pieces of user-facing text still describe three modes.

### What I ran and read
- Read issue #1195 and every changed line (`actions.rs`, `panes.rs`, `mod.rs`, `tests.rs`, `machine_mode_tests.rs`, the decision file), plus `posting::MACHINES`, `machine::library::builtins`, `operation::shown_for` / `Section::ORDER`, and each place a machine kind becomes a caption (`panes.rs` 299, 317, 343, 383, 672, 851-875, 1217-1248).
- Trial merge with `origin/main` (d7e9a807): already up to date, no conflicts. GitHub says MERGEABLE.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`): **581 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored**. All 4 `machine_mode_tests`, `the_machine_door_switches_workspaces_and_rides_undo` and `the_machine_door_wears_its_workspace` pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD -- crates/ui/tests/snapshots`: empty. No snapshot PNG is touched.

### What looks good
- The machine name `"Tormach 1300PL"` (`actions.rs:36`) matches `posting::MACHINES` (`crates/app/src/posting.rs:187`) exactly.
- `every_mode_mounts_a_shipped_machine_of_its_own_kind` checks each row's name against `library::builtins()`, which is `posting::MACHINES` and not a hand list, and also checks the machine's kind. `every_kind_with_a_shipped_machine_has_a_mode` gets its kinds from the same source. So if a wire or sinker EDM machine ships without a row, the test fails, and if someone adds an EDM row before a machine ships, the test also fails. Good.
- The switch path is unchanged. `set_machine_mode` (`actions.rs:69-80`) pushes one `LoadBuiltinMachine`, and its guard means picking the current mode pushes nothing. The new behaviour test covers Milling -> Plasma -> Milling, the repeated-pick no-op (`state.pending.is_empty()`), Plasma Profile becoming enabled and then disabled, and two undos back to the mill.
- The door test change (`tests.rs:2580`, `3` -> `4`) is a correct update. The test still clicks row 0 (current, nothing mounts) and row 1 (Turning), so nothing was weakened. Nothing else assumed three modes: `machine_rows` enumerates the table, there is no index access, no shortcut and no cycling action.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` was added, no Flecs or world-level calls in the UI, and the section labels come from the registry (`shown_for` + `Section::label`). The door icon already maps `Kind::Plasma` (`panes.rs:680`).

### Requested before merge
1. **The ribbon door now wears the menu-row text** (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs:317-318`, used by `text_of` at `panes.rs:343`). `mode_caption` now returns `mode_label`, so the door cell on the ribbon (a cell about 43 px wide) reads "Turning - Turning…", "Mill-turning - Turning…" or "Plasma cutting - Plasma…" instead of the one word its own doc comment describes. The PR body only mentions the menu rows. Fix: keep `mode_caption` as it was (the bare caption from `MACHINE_MODES`, `&'static str`) for the door, and call `actions::mode_label(*kind)` only in the dropdown rows (`panes.rs:1246` and `1248`).
2. **Stale text still says three modes.** The door tooltip (`panes.rs:383`) still says "Switch the workspace: Milling, Turning or Mill-turning ...", so the user is never told Plasma cutting exists. Add Plasma cutting, or better, build the list from `MACHINE_MODES` so it can't drift again. Also fix the `machine_rows` doc comment (`panes.rs:851`, "the three workspaces").
3. **`actions.rs` grew from 433 to 458 lines, and that growth was avoidable.** Move `MACHINE_MODES`, `mode_label` and `set_machine_mode` (about 55 lines, one clear concern) into a small `crates/ui/src/machine_modes.rs` with a provenance line, and re-export or update the three users (`panes.rs`, `tests.rs`, `machine_mode_tests.rs`). That brings `actions.rs` back to about 400 lines. AGENTS.md "400-line files" says to split along the domain seam instead of growing a file that is already over the limit.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- **Row wording.** "Turning - Turning" repeats itself. Simplest rule: add the suffix only for sections whose label does not already appear in the caption (case-insensitive). The rows would then read Milling / Turning / Mill-turning / Plasma cutting - Plasma, which also fixes the next point. "Mill-turning - Turning" is accurate but undersells the mode, since a mill-turn also keeps every mill section. The suffix means "adds to a mill", which the row doesn't say.
- **Row width.** "Mill-turning - Turning  (current)" is about 33 characters at `font_row`, which is likely wider than the 200 px panel (`DROP_W`, `panes.rs:876`). The painter does not clip, so the text would run past the panel edge. The rule above avoids this. Otherwise, size the panel to the widest row.
- **Done means asked for a derived list.** The issue's "Done means" asks for "the mode list is derived from the built-in machines" so an EDM mode "appears by itself". The PR keeps the explicit table and records why in the decision file (there is no rule yet for picking the reference machine). The two tests make a missing row fail loudly instead of filling it in automatically. For safety this is equivalent, but it doesn't meet the wording. The maintainer should accept the deviation or ask for the derivation. A simple rule exists: the first built-in of each kind in `MACHINES` order already gives VMC 3-axis, Lathe (check the order), Mill-turn and Tormach 1300PL.
- **EDM captions.** With a wire or sinker machine mounted from the Setup picker, there is no row, so the door reads "Machine…" and no row is marked "(current)". That is the same as before and honest, not a lie.
- **Unreadable built-ins.** `every_kind_with_a_shipped_machine_has_a_mode` uses `filter_map(|e| e.kind)`, so a built-in that doesn't parse is skipped silently. Other library tests probably cover this already.
- The undo assertions check the machine kind, not the machine name (for example that undo brings back "VMC 3-axis" itself). This is fine because `LoadMachine`'s invert is tested elsewhere.
- `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #1195` are present, the commit subject is conventional, and the decision file records the choices and what was dropped.

Not exercised: nothing was looked at on screen (no GUI launch). The door and row width findings come from reading the code.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: fe37c1ae2e7b2de5bc0ff3fab31df4dcee0ad30f -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a re-review of the changes since 90c8810a: the author's fix commit 0b1916a9 plus a merge of main. All three requested changes are fixed, and I found no new defects.

### What I ran and read
- Diff 90c8810a..fe37c1ae and `origin/main...HEAD`. The PR's own changes are only `actions.rs`, `machine_modes.rs` (new), `lib.rs`, `egui_app/{panes.rs,mod.rs,tests.rs,machine_mode_tests.rs}` and the decision file. The other files in the delta (view file, gizmo labels, the 200 -> 221 row offsets in `tests.rs`) came in with the merge of main.
- Trial merge with current `origin/main`: already up to date. GitHub says MERGEABLE. No snapshot PNG changed (`git diff --stat origin/main HEAD -- crates/ui/tests/snapshots` is empty).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`): **593 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored**.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean (I checked that it re-checks `camcraft-ui`).

### The three requested changes
1. **Door caption: fixed.** The door uses `machine_modes::caption` (`panes.rs:338`), which returns the bare caption from the table as `&'static str`. Only the menu rows use `mode_label` (`panes.rs:1264-1267`). The new test `the_door_wears_the_plain_caption_for_every_mode` mounts each mode's machine and checks that the door reads `"<caption>…"`.
2. **Tooltip and comments: fixed.** The tip is built from the table by `modes_phrase()` (`panes.rs:378-381`), and `the_door_tip_lists_every_mode` plus the updated `tips_match_the_imgui_table` text pin it. The "three workspaces" wording is gone from `machine_rows`, the `Cmd::Machine` doc and the dropdown comment.
3. **Split: done.** `crates/ui/src/machine_modes.rs` is 83 lines and has its provenance line. `actions.rs` is 400 lines. Nothing is duplicated: no `actions::MACHINE_MODES`, `actions::set_machine_mode`, `mode_label` or `mode_caption` is left anywhere, and every caller compiles through `machine_modes::`. `set_machine_mode` is unchanged: the same already-current check, one `LoadBuiltinMachine` of the table's name, and the same status line.

### The rework
- **Suffix rule.** A section label is dropped when the caption already contains it (`machine_modes.rs:57`, case-sensitive). The rows are Milling / Turning / Mill-turning - Turning / Plasma cutting. "Mill-turning" does not contain "Turning" with a capital T, which is why the mill-turn row keeps its suffix. That is what the registry gives: `shown_for(MillTurn)` minus the mill sections is only Turning. A mill-turn keeps every mill section, so "what it adds to a mill" is accurate, and the decision file says so.
- **Discoverability.** Discoverability holds. The "Plasma cutting" row is itself what tells the user the plasma section exists.
- **Tests.** The old pin `"Plasma cutting - Plasma"` changed to `"Plasma cutting"`. That follows the agreed wording change and is not a weakening: the new test pins all four rows instead of two. Both shipped-machine tests (`library::builtins()` = `posting::MACHINES`) and the switch, no-op and undo test are unchanged apart from the module path.
- **Menu width.** The menu is the longest row (with "  (current)") measured in the row font, plus 2 x 8 px padding, and never narrower than `DROP_W`. The panel and the rows use the same width.

### Notes (not blocking)
- `the_machine_door_switches_workspaces_and_rides_undo` (`tests.rs:2581`) passes a fixed `200.0` width to `machine_rows` instead of the measured width. Its clicks land at the row centres, which are inside the real (wider or equal) rows, so the test is still valid.
- The `"Machine"` fallback caption remains for the EDM kinds, which have no mode row. That is honest and unchanged from main.
- `Changelog:` and `Fixes #1195` are present. The PR body states exactly what the door, the tip and the menu rows show.
- Not exercised: nothing was looked at on screen (no GUI launch).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
